model: StandardScaler + LogisticRegression(C=1, effective class/file balanced, seed=42)
positive_labels: weak: loudest 200 ms core inherits positive clip label
negative_labels: Kaggle negative clip label and full prompted breathing recordings
threshold_policy: validation-only: minimum 95% recall of v2-positive Kaggle snore cores; maximize full validation breathing rejection
production_promotion: requires independently human-timestamped validation; no automatic promotion
old_test_policy: diagnostic, previously inspected; never train or select threshold on test
